why: An addendum whose ministry heading is followed by a bare name line in capitals (PROF S. JAYAKUMAR) is attributed to that minister; the pattern accepted only a line of the shape Mr Name and a heading with no inner bold.
title: ADDENDA, MINISTRY OF LAW
html:
MINISTRY OF LAW

PROF S. JAYAKUMAR

Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Law

MinLaw will strengthen the legal infrastructure.

Legal

We will work closely with the profession.
